outcomes.title: Critical Thinking & Problem Solving
outcomes.description: Ability to analyze complex problems, evaluate evidence, and develop effective solutions using logical reasoning and creative approaches.
outcomes.interpretation: Demonstrates strong analytical skills with consistent application of critical thinking in academic tasks. Shows ability to evaluate multiple perspectives and form evidence-based conclusions.

indicators.text: Analyzes complex problems using appropriate strategies

outcomes.title: Communication & Collaboration
outcomes.description: Ability to convey ideas effectively through various mediums and work productively with diverse teams to achieve common goals.
outcomes.interpretation: Shows solid communication skills in both written and verbal forms. Works well in team settings and demonstrates respect for diverse perspectives.

indicators.text: Expresses ideas clearly in written form
Adapts communication style for different audiences

outcomes.title: Leadership & Social Responsibility
outcomes.description: Ability to lead by example, take initiative, and contribute positively to community welfare and social development.
outcomes.interpretation: Demonstrates emerging leadership qualities with growing awareness of social responsibility. Shows willingness to take initiative and contribute to group efforts.

outcomes.title: Lifelong Learning & Adaptability
outcomes.description: Commitment to continuous personal and professional growth, with ability to adapt to changing circumstances and embrace new challenges.
outcomes.interpretation: Exceptional commitment to continuous learning. Demonstrates high adaptability and shows proactive approach to acquiring new skills and knowledge.

indicators.text: Stays current with developments in field

outcomes.title: Research & Innovation
outcomes.description: Ability to conduct quality research, think innovatively, and apply research findings to address real-world problems.
outcomes.interpretation: Shows developing research skills with growing understanding of research methodology. Demonstrates creative thinking and application of research to practical problems.
